Update: EURUSD and USDJPY: two falling quotes, two dollar directions

EURUSD fell. USDJPY fell. Those October 26-30 Fed reference rates meant a stronger dollar against the euro and a weaker one against the yen.

What to watch: A split dollar response across the two currencies would challenge an explanation built on one common dollar driver.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/eurusd-and-usdjpy-two-falling-quotes

Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.
